sources.title: Qwen3 0.6B Heretic Abliterated Uncensored - llmrun.dev
sources.snippet: Qwen3 0.6B Heretic Abliterated Uncensored — Hardware Requirements & GPU Compatibility Chat Qwen3 0.6B Heretic Abliterated Uncensored is a 596M-parameter open language model from DavidAU in the Qwen 3 family. It supports a context window of up to 40,960 tokens. At Q4_K_M it needs about 0.78 GB of VRAM — see which GPUs and Macs can run it below.

sources.title: DavidAU/Qwen3-0.6B-heretic-abliterated-uncensored
sources.snippet: DavidAU/Qwen3-.6B-heretic-abliterated-uncensored is a 0.8 billion parameter Qwen3-based language model, uncensored using the Heretic v1.0.1 method. It achieves a refusal rate of 6/100 and a KL divergence of 0.00, indicating minimal damage to the model's original state while significantly reducing censorship. sources.snippet: It is being used more like a semantic prompt interpreter: the text is converted into conditioning information that the image model then uses. Because of that, the benefit of using an abliterated model seems questionable at best.
